title: HYPE M1 episode-aware expanding walk-forward audit

leakage_guard.features: completed M1 only: trailing-extreme strength, candidate-event history, retrace, realized volatility, path efficiency, executed buy/sell flow and pre-candidate M1 structure

comparison.interpretation: candidate-history and causal M1 path/flow features materially improve first-signal discrimination, but do not reach the pre-registered 0.80 precision gate.

hard120_context.verdict: HARD120 remains the stronger primary precision layer; July/Aug precision passes 0.80 but recall misses the 0.40 gate, concentrated in HIGH.

next_action: Keep HARD120 frozen; use the episode-aware M1 model as a research challenger and target HIGH recall/precision separately without changing the primary contract.
